items.name: biscotti-foundation
items.title: Biscotti UI foundation
items.description: Tokens (CSS variables + Tailwind v4 theme), motion springs, the synthesised sound engine, utilities, primitives and icons.

items.name: action-toolbar
items.title: Contextual Action Toolbar
items.description: Shows a toolbar at the text selection. Link and Comment open an inline input in the toolbar.

items.name: activity-stack
items.title: Agent Activity Stack
items.description: Lists concurrent agent tasks by urgency. Collapses finished tasks into a stack.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Human Approval Card
items.description: Asks for approval before an agent acts. After a decision, it shows a receipt that you can undo.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Searches commands with ⌘K. Supports fuzzy ranking, nested pages and async results.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Smart Data Table
items.description: Sorts, selects and updates live records. Keeps focus and selection on the same rows.

items.name: diff-inspector
items.title: Interactive Diff Inspector
items.description: Reviews proposed edits one hunk at a time. Applies accepted changes to the document.

items.name: filter-builder
items.title: Visual Filter Builder
items.description: Builds filters from typed clauses. Shows the matching results while you edit.

items.name: insight-card
items.title: Insight Card
items.description: Shows one KPI with animated digits, a scrubbable SVG chart and a one-sentence insight.

items.name: interactive-slider
items.title: Interactive Slider
items.description: A precision slider with a ruler, snap points and fine adjustment with Shift.

items.name: kinetic-button
items.title: Kinetic Button
items.description: A button that shows pending, success and error states. Supports hold to confirm.

items.name: mention-picker
items.title: Contextual Mention Picker
items.description: Finds people, files and tools at the caret. Inserts the selection as one token.

items.name: notifications
items.title: Notification & Feedback System
items.description: Shows stacked toasts with undo countdowns and progress. Callout shows persistent messages.

items.name: precision-toggle
items.title: Precision Toggle
items.description: A switch that stays pending in pencil until the save is complete.

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: Intelligent Prompt Composer
items.description: A prompt input with file uploads, inline references and slash commands.

items.name: property-editor
items.title: Inline Property Editor
items.description: An inspector with drag-to-change numbers, a colour picker and an editable box model.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Selects one option from a set. The indicator moves its leading edge first.

items.name: streaming-response
items.title: Streaming Response
items.description: Renders a text stream as Markdown, with chunk fades, citations and a pencil caret.

items.name: thinking-timeline
items.title: Thinking Timeline
items.description: Shows agent progress as steps. Collapses into a past-tense summary when the run ends.

items.name: tool-chip
items.title: Tool Execution Chip
items.description: Shows one inline chip per tool call. Opens in place to show the input and output.

items.name: workflow-stepper
items.title: Workflow Stepper
items.description: Shows a multi-step run as dependency lanes that split, run in parallel and merge.
